name: Ferienwohnung Pfluger
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Ferienwohnung Pfluger in the quaint Thiersee is an ideal starting point for exploring the impressive Kaisergebirgsregion. Located in a quiet spot at the foot of the Zahme Kaiser, it offers a fantastic view of the surrounding Alpine scenery. Guests can expect a modern and comfortably furnished holiday apartment, complete with a fully equipped kitchen and a cozy living area. Directly outside the front door, numerous begin in the summer, while the idyllic Thiersee invites you to swim and relax. In the winter months, the nearby ski resorts such as Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental and the cross-country ski trails around the lake are a thrill. The combination of Alpine tranquility and proximity to Festung Kufstein makes the stay an unforgettable nature and cultural experience.
